purpose: A decision method for a micro AI-design D2C knitwear brand on whether to design-and-build its own knitting machine, buy new, buy used, or subcontract into the Ludhiana job-work mesh, and on where AI and reverse-engineering genuinely add leverage versus where they are hype. It fixes the make-vs-buy boundary at the right subsystem (the binding constraints are the machine-specific CAD/flat-knit programmer and the linker, not the iron), holds 'design our own machine' as the highest-confidence NEVER (~$2M-10M+ over 3-7 years for a likely-inferior result vs a sub-$20k used machine that already works), confines reverse-engineering and 3D-printing to periphery and maintenance and never the core kinematic chain, separates real AI leverage (design->knit-program assist, predictive maintenance, vision defect detection) from hype (fabricating the iron, replacing the programmer or linker), and tags every money/capacity/performance/regulation claim [FACT], [ESTIMATE] (method+basis+confidence, literal word 'estimate'), or [UNKNOWN] so the honesty discipline survives into the forged KB prose.
assumptions: the venture is a deliberately small, fast-iterating D2C capsule brand sourcing fully-fashioned acrylic/acrylic-blend knitwear in Ludhiana and selling in California/Turlock, per SCOPE_GLOSSARY

no landed used-machine quote is supplied; every price, MOQ-equivalent, throughput and lead-time figure is a labeled [ESTIMATE] with stated confidence, never a fake-precise fact, and named-firm figures are never fabricated
machine acquisition is a Phase-1 (proven-volume) decision, not a launch move; the launch default is subcontracting knit+link+finish into the job-work mesh per the T3 deep-dive
the two computerised flat-knit toolchains are vendor-locked and non-interchangeable: Shima SDS-ONE APEX / APEXFiz versus Stoll M1plus / knitelligence; a Shima program is not a Stoll program
Groz-Beckert supplies needles even to Shima and Stoll [FACT], so a micro-brand machining its own needles competes with a 170-year metallurgy specialist at its own game
the design->knit-program autonomy of AI on our specific acrylic/blend fabrics is [UNKNOWN] and is delegated to T8 to test rather than assumed here

the highest-leverage confirmations for the uncertain figures are real landed used-machine quotes (machine + freight + ~7.5% BCD + 18% IGST under HSN 8447 + install) and on-the-ground Ludhiana programmer/linker availability and rates
exclusions: the full per-style manufacturing cost model and job-work piece rates — covered by the T4 manufacturing-economics specialist
yarn and fibre selection, count and blend decisions — covered by the T2 yarn specialist
the generative design pipeline itself (model choice, prompt-to-pattern) — covered by the T8 AI-design specialist; this KB only judges the design->program HANDOFF feasibility
vision-QC model training and the full quality program — covered by the T5 quality specialist; this KB only judges vision-QC as an AI-leverage candidate
landed-cost and US-import duty on the finished garment (heading 6110) and unit economics — covered by T9
any fabricated named-firm revenue, capacity, or price stated as fact

glossary.definition: The venture's recurring central lever applied to the iron: design-and-build vs buy-new vs buy-used vs subcontract. For a micro FF-sweater line the boundary sits below the core kinematic chain — never build it — and the binding constraints are the CAD/flat-knit programmer and the linker, not the machine.

The decades-deep, precision-defended subsystems of a computerised V-bed machine — needle bed, needles, cam systems, electronic needle-selection, controller firmware, and knit-CAD software — that cannot be skipped, faked, or cloned; the part that makes 'build your own' the highest-confidence NEVER.

The scarce, winnable, machine-specific (Shima SDS-ONE APEX/APEXFiz vs Stoll M1plus/knitelligence) human skill that authors every needle action, stitch structure, FF shaping, carrier move and racking sequence; a harder constraint than acquiring the machine and the hinge of the strategy for an AI-design brand.

The eyesight-intensive, hand-skilled, piece-rate loop-to-loop seaming step that joins FF panels into the defining flat near-invisible stretchy seam; it sets a small line's daily ceiling, not the knitting machine — the role T1 names hardest to re-hire after the lean season.

The Phase-0 launch posture: knit+link+finish via the Ludhiana job-work agglomeration, owning only design+brand+(optionally) one cheap used hand-flat for sampling, so capital stays free for design and CAC and the cluster supplies the small, fast, varied runs an AI-design brand lives on.

A wide, confidence-tagged range for a machine or process cost, built from method+basis and carrying the literal word estimate; never a quote. Tidy single figures (e.g. a ~$15k used Chinese machine) are decision-framing illustrations, downgraded to wide LOW-MED bands until real landed quotes (machine+freight+duty+install) confirm.

The landed-cost build-up on a machine imported into India: assessable value + ~7.5% BCD (+~0.75% surcharge) + 18% IGST under HS heading 8447 [FACT on classification, [ESTIMATE] on the exact BCD sub-heading], plus install, power/compressed-air infrastructure, spares, and ex-Stoll parts-via-Obertshausen service.

Reverse-engineering, own-parts and 3D-printing help on jigs, fixtures, alignment gauges, non-critical spares and maintenance (learning cam timing, scanning worn obsolete brackets) — but NEVER on the core kinematic chain or firmware/knit-CAD cloning, which destroys money and adds IP/legal exposure.

AI is real on design->knit-program assist (bridge to T8), predictive maintenance on used iron, and vision defect detection (T5); it is hype on fabricating the iron and overstated on replacing the programmer or linker. It relaxes the programmer constraint and improves uptime/QC but does not solve metrology or cam profiles.

Shima WHOLEGARMENT / Stoll knit&wear seamless single-piece knitting that deletes the entire linking step and its bottleneck, but is the highest-capital, steepest-programming, slower-per-garment class; a later/volume trade study (T4), never a launch decision, with micro-economics held [UNKNOWN].

nodes.definition: Catalog the three machine families plus finishing that make a fully-fashioned sweater, and locate the make-vs-buy boundary for each. The flat-bed (V-bed) machine knits and shapes FF panels back-and-forth (Shima Seiki [Japan], Stoll [Germany], the Chinese tier led by Cixing) and is the core sweater technology; its whole-garment sub-family knits the entire seamless garment in one piece. Circular knitting makes a fast jersey tube for later cut-&-sew. The linker seams FF panels loop-to-loop. Finishing (steam/board/wash/soften) turns a harsh off-machine panel into retail product. The load-bearing point: the knitting machine's value lives in its program, not its metal [FACT on family identities; SCOPE_GLOSSARY S3].

nodes.definition: Establish subcontracting into the Ludhiana job-work mesh as the Phase-0 launch default for a capsule brand. Knit+link+finish are bought as job-work (the principal owns the material and pays a conversion charge), owning only design+brand+(optionally) one cheap used hand-flat for in-house sampling. The agglomeration IS the infrastructure — the one Ludhiana moat that helps a tiny brand — and small-batch/iteration fit is its genuine edge for our use case; capital stays free for design and CAC. Subcontract wins because a deliberately tiny, iterating capsule brand usually won't hit the utilisation that justifies an owned line, whose mid-six-figure-plus skilled-staffing commitment lands before a single garment sells.

conflict_axes.name: vision_qc_accuracy_cited_vs_transferable
conflict_axes.description: Cited vision-QC accuracy of 91-96% is a fact for those datasets but not a guarantee on our acrylic/blend knits.
poles: treat accuracy as unvalidated on our knits
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: carry 91-96% as dataset-specific [FACT-not-transferable]; require T5 validation on our samples before relying on it

conflict_axes.name: estimate_band_vs_decisive_price
conflict_axes.description: Rigorous [ESTIMATE] price banding protects honesty but a buyer wants a single decisive number, and used capital-goods price is condition-specific.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: give the band with confidence and a confirmation path (landed quote); never fake-precise a single figure as fact

conflict_axes.name: wholegarment_no_linking_vs_capital_and_programming
conflict_axes.description: Whole-garment deletes the linker bottleneck but is the highest-capital, steepest-programming class with [UNKNOWN] micro-economics at small scale.
poles: defer whole-garment until volume justifies it
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold whole-garment as a later T4 trade study; its no-linking upside pays only at a volume that justifies the capital and programming

conflict_axes.name: stoll_new_off_table_vs_used_pool_deepens
conflict_axes.description: The 2025 Stoll exit removes Stoll new-build but deepens the ex-Stoll used pool, which cuts both ways for a buyer.
poles: avoid ex-Stoll iron on service risk
buy the deepening cheap ex-Stoll pool
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: use the deepening used pool but price the Obertshausen-only parts-and-service diligence into any ex-Stoll buy

edge_cases.description: A founder is tempted to build a bespoke machine because it looks strategically differentiating
edge_cases.trigger: the build option is judged on control/differentiation without pricing it against a used machine
edge_cases.mitigation: apply build-NEVER as a hard override: ~$2M-10M+/3-7yr for a likely-inferior result vs a sub-$20k used machine, with the core chain supplier-defended

edge_cases.description: Reverse-engineering creeps from periphery onto the core kinematic chain or firmware/knit-CAD cloning
edge_cases.trigger: a successful peripheral 3D-print emboldens an attempt at needles, selection, or firmware
edge_cases.mitigation: hold the periphery-yes-chain-never line and flag the IP/legal exposure of cloning selection/firmware/knit-CAD

edge_cases.description: A tidy single price (a ~$15k used Chinese machine) is quoted as a fact in a cost model
edge_cases.trigger: an illustrative single figure is committed into a T4 capex line without a landed quote
edge_cases.mitigation: downgrade single figures to wide LOW-MED [ESTIMATE] bands and route to a real landed quote (machine+freight+duty+install) before committing

edge_cases.description: The AI pipeline is designed assuming AI auto-programs our fabrics with no programmer
edge_cases.trigger: design->program autonomy on acrylic/blend FF is assumed before T8 tests it
edge_cases.mitigation: hold autonomy [UNKNOWN] for T8 to test, and design the pipeline around AI as a programmer multiplier plus real sampling

edge_cases.description: The cited 91-96% vision-QC accuracy is promised on our acrylic/blend knits
edge_cases.trigger: a dataset-specific accuracy is quoted as a transferable guarantee
edge_cases.mitigation: carry 91-96% as dataset-specific [FACT-not-transferable] and require T5 validation on our samples

edge_cases.description: An owned line is planned off knitting-machine count, stranding output at the linker
edge_cases.trigger: capacity is sized by knitting machines without matched linker and programmer capacity
edge_cases.mitigation: size capacity off the linker ceiling and match linkers/programmer to knitting output before counting machines

edge_cases.description: An ex-Stoll used machine is bought without pricing the Obertshausen-only parts-and-service risk
edge_cases.trigger: a cheap ex-Stoll machine is judged on sticker price after the 2025 exit
edge_cases.mitigation: add the ex-Stoll parts-and-service diligence (Obertshausen-only) as a cost line before any ex-Stoll buy

edge_cases.description: A machine is bought on the sticker price without the HSN 8447 landed import stack
edge_cases.trigger: a used-machine band is committed without BCD+IGST+freight+install
edge_cases.mitigation: compute landed = price + freight + ~7.5% BCD + 18% IGST + install under HSN 8447 before any buy decision

edge_cases.description: Whole-garment is bought at launch for its no-linking appeal before volume justifies the capital
edge_cases.trigger: the linker-deletion advantage is pursued without a volume program
edge_cases.mitigation: defer whole-garment to a T4 volume trade study; its micro-economics at small scale are [UNKNOWN]

edge_cases.description: Stoll is treated as a live new-build option after the 2025 exit
edge_cases.trigger: a new-build comparison still includes Stoll
edge_cases.mitigation: narrow new-build to Shima + Chinese; Stoll new is effectively end-of-line per the Oct-2025 [FACT]

edge_cases.description: OpenKnit's hobby feasibility is read as commercial-gauge feasibility
edge_cases.trigger: an open-hardware proof-of-concept is cited to argue a buildable commercial machine
edge_cases.mitigation: note OpenKnit is nowhere near commercial gauge/speed/reliability/FF-shaping; serious research is software-only

edge_cases.description: A landed quote arrives and contradicts the estimated price bands and buy-vs-subcontract call
edge_cases.trigger: a real machine+freight+duty+install quote becomes available
edge_cases.mitigation: fire the review loop, replace the band with the quote, and re-derive the buy-vs-subcontract verdict

workflow.action: Map the machine families and locate the make-vs-buy boundary
workflow.description: Record flat-bed/whole-garment, circular, linker and finishing with the program-not-metal point
workflow.gate: the three families plus finishing are named with FF/C&S roles and the flat-bed vendor tier

workflow.action: Establish the linker and programmer bottlenecks
workflow.description: State the linker as the capacity ceiling and the machine-specific programmer as the hinge
workflow.gate: both bottlenecks are named, the programmer tied to Shima-vs-Stoll toolchains and the AI-design hand-off

workflow.action: Build the per-class price bands and landed import stack
workflow.description: Give new/used [ESTIMATE] bands with confidence and compute the HSN 8447 landed stack
workflow.gate: each class has confidence-tagged bands, the single-figure downgrade is explicit, and landed cost is computed under HSN 8447

workflow.action: Set the subcontract default and the buy-used threshold
workflow.description: State subcontract at capsule scale and buy-used (Chinese first) only at proven volume
workflow.gate: subcontract is the launch posture and buy-used is gated on a proven repeating program filling machine+programmer+linkers

workflow.action: Carry the Stoll exit and narrow the new-build choice
workflow.description: State the Oct-2025 Stoll exit [FACT] and narrow new to Shima + Chinese
workflow.gate: the Stoll exit, Obertshausen-only parts and deepening used pool are stated and new-build is narrowed

workflow.action: Settle the build-vs-buy verdict and the kinematic-chain wall
workflow.description: State build-NEVER (~$2M-10M+ vs sub-$20k used) with the chain wall, Groz-Beckert and software-only research
workflow.gate: building is stated as the highest-confidence NEVER with the cost comparison and the two settling facts

workflow.action: Confine reverse-engineering to periphery and maintenance
workflow.description: State the periphery+maintenance DO and the core-chain+cloning DON'T with the IP caveat
workflow.gate: the DO and DON'T lists are both stated with the periphery-yes-chain-never rule

workflow.action: Map real AI leverage and reject the hype
workflow.description: State design->program assist, predictive maintenance and vision QC as real, reject machine-fabrication and programmer/linker replacement
workflow.gate: real uses are named and the hype claims rejected, with autonomy on our fabrics held [UNKNOWN]

workflow.action: Hold whole-garment as a later volume trade
workflow.description: State whole-garment deletes linking but is highest-capital/steepest-programming with [UNKNOWN] micro-economics
workflow.gate: whole-garment is held as a T4 trade study, not a launch move, with micro-economics [UNKNOWN]

workflow.description: Give the illustrative owned-line staffing and output [ESTIMATE] behind the subcontract default
workflow.gate: the mid-six-figure-plus staffing illustration is stated [ESTIMATE, LOW-MED] with the T4-rebuild caveat

workflow.action: Compose the build/buy/subcontract verdict under the honesty guardrail
workflow.description: Combine all reads into subcontract->buy-used->never-build with the build-NEVER and chain/AI overrides
workflow.gate: the verdict composes the upstream reads, applies build-NEVER as a hard override, and tags every figure per the guardrail

workflow.action: Set the feasibility review cadence and triggers
workflow.description: Define the refresh cadence and material-change triggers routing back to the bands, verdict and bottlenecks
workflow.gate: a cadence and a trigger list (landed quotes highest-leverage) routing to the price bands, verdict and bottlenecks exist

dominance_rules.rule: The build-NEVER verdict dominates any control/differentiation case for building a machine
dominance_rules.rationale: the core kinematic chain is supplier-defended and a self-built machine would be inferior at ~$2M-10M+ vs a sub-$20k used machine
dominance_rules.trigger: the build option is raised on strategic or control grounds
dominance_rules.action: refuse the build and route to buy-used or subcontract

dominance_rules.rule: The honesty guardrail dominates any pressure for a single decisive price or performance number
dominance_rules.rationale: used capital-goods price and AI accuracy are condition/dataset-specific, so an over-decisive figure would be fake-precise
dominance_rules.trigger: a request for one machine price or a guaranteed AI accuracy
dominance_rules.action: answer with a confidence-tagged [ESTIMATE] band or dataset-specific [FACT] plus a confirmation path

dominance_rules.rule: The periphery/chain line dominates any reverse-engineering ambition
dominance_rules.rationale: core-chain or firmware/knit-CAD cloning destroys money and adds IP exposure while periphery work saves uptime
dominance_rules.trigger: reverse-engineering is proposed for a needle/bed/cam/selection/firmware part
dominance_rules.action: confine it to periphery and maintenance; refuse the core chain

dominance_rules.rule: The programmer and linker constraints dominate the machine in any capacity or hiring plan
dominance_rules.rationale: the iron is cheaper and more available than the scarce programmer and linker that actually cap output
dominance_rules.trigger: a plan sizes capacity or capital off machine count
dominance_rules.action: size off the linker ceiling and the programmer availability first

dominance_rules.rule: The buy-used threshold dominates any premature ownership ambition
dominance_rules.rationale: ownership only pays once a proven program at sustained volume fills the machine, programmer and linkers
dominance_rules.trigger: a machine buy is proposed before proven volume
dominance_rules.action: hold the subcontract default until the proven-volume threshold is met

dominance_rules.rule: The AI hype boundary dominates any claim that AI replaces the programmer, linker, or iron
dominance_rules.rationale: AI does not solve metrology or close the program loop on our fabrics unproven, and does not replace the hand seam
dominance_rules.trigger: an AI capability is assumed beyond assist/multiplier on program/maintenance/QC
dominance_rules.action: reject the claim and hold design->program autonomy [UNKNOWN] for T8

dominance_rules.rule: The Stoll-exit structure dominates a new-build comparison that still includes Stoll
dominance_rules.rationale: Stoll flat-knit new is effectively end-of-line after the Oct-2025 exit
dominance_rules.trigger: Stoll is listed as a live new-build option
dominance_rules.action: narrow new-build to Shima + Chinese and treat ex-Stoll only as a diligence-priced used buy

dominance_rules.rule: A flagged low-confidence input dominates a confident downstream conclusion built on it
dominance_rules.rationale: a conclusion cannot be more certain than its weakest load-bearing input (a price band or an [UNKNOWN] autonomy)
dominance_rules.trigger: a verdict leans on a wide [ESTIMATE] band or an [UNKNOWN] as if it were solid
dominance_rules.action: cap the conclusion's confidence at the weakest input and name its confirmation source

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the make-vs-buy boundary at the subsystem (programmer/linker, not the iron) before sizing any buy
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a capacity or capital plan built on machine count that must be redone once the true bottleneck is recognised

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tag every price/throughput/performance figure [FACT]/[ESTIMATE]/[UNKNOWN] at the moment it is written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a later honesty sweep that must re-caveat figures already stated as facts

anti_rework_rules.rule: Downgrade tidy single price figures to wide bands and attach the landed-quote path the first time a price is given
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a cost model committed on an illustrative single figure that must be torn up when a landed quote lands

anti_rework_rules.rule: Compute the HSN 8447 landed stack alongside the sticker band, not after the buy
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a buy decision made on the sticker that must be reworked once duty and install are added

anti_rework_rules.rule: Hold the build option as a settled NEVER rather than re-litigating it per decision
anti_rework_rules.prevents: repeated re-analysis of a build whose verdict the kinematic-chain wall and cost comparison already settle

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confine reverse-engineering to periphery and maintenance when the scope is first drawn
anti_rework_rules.prevents: effort sunk into a core-chain clone that the periphery/chain line then voids

anti_rework_rules.rule: Hold AI design->program autonomy on our fabrics [UNKNOWN] for T8 rather than assuming it in the pipeline
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a pipeline designed on assumed autonomy that must be re-architected when T8 returns a negative result

anti_rework_rules.rule: Name the confirmation source (landed quote, T8 test, programmer rate) on every low-confidence figure as it is stated
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a later pass to attach confirmation paths to numbers already published without them

iteration_protocol.trigger: real landed used-machine quotes (machine + freight + ~7.5% BCD + 18% IGST + install) become available
iteration_protocol.action: replace the price bands with the quotes and re-derive the buy-vs-subcontract verdict

iteration_protocol.trigger: on-the-ground Ludhiana programmer and linker availability and rates are confirmed
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the bottleneck reads and re-balance AI-assist vs hired program layer

iteration_protocol.trigger: T8 returns a result on design->knit-program autonomy on our acrylic/blend fabrics
iteration_protocol.action: update the AI design->program read and the hype boundary's [UNKNOWN] hold

iteration_protocol.trigger: ex-Stoll parts-and-service cost and availability post-Reutlingen are confirmed
iteration_protocol.action: re-price the ex-Stoll used diligence and re-read the buy-used and new-build narrowing

iteration_protocol.trigger: T5 validates vision-QC accuracy on our acrylic/blend knits
iteration_protocol.action: replace the dataset-specific 91-96% caveat with the validated accuracy and update the AI map

iteration_protocol.trigger: a style reaches a proven repeating program at sustained volume
iteration_protocol.action: cross the buy-used threshold and run the owned-line vs subcontract economics

iteration_protocol.trigger: a T4 whole-garment micro-economics trade study is run
iteration_protocol.action: update the whole-garment hold and the linker-bottleneck-deletion read

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new flat-knit vendor or a Stoll-revival event changes the market structure
iteration_protocol.action: re-read the family map, the price bands and the new-build narrowing

priority_rationale: The machine-family map, the linker and programmer bottlenecks are foundational because every downstream buy, build and AI read depends on where the make-vs-buy boundary and the binding constraints sit; the price bands and the HSN 8447 import stack precede the subcontract-default and buy-used-threshold decisions they cost; the Stoll-exit structure narrows the new-build choice; the build-NEVER verdict and the kinematic-chain wall settle the build question and bound the periphery reverse-engineering rule; the AI nodes (design->program, predictive maintenance, vision QC) map real leverage and the hype boundary rejects the rest while holding autonomy [UNKNOWN]; the honesty guardrail governs every dollar and performance expression; and the composed verdict plus the review loop come last because they compose all upstream reads into a subcontract->buy-used->never-build decision and a self-correcting refresh keyed to landed quotes and T8/T5 results.
